questions.prompt: At dawn the enemy seized the top of the mountain.
questions.answer: Prīmā lūce hostēs summum montem occupāvērunt.

questions.prompt: In the middle of the river a huge rock was standing.
questions.answer: In mediō flūmine ingēns saxum stābat.

questions.prompt: Exhausted, we rested in the deepest part of the valley.
questions.answer: Fessī in īmā valle quiēvimus.

questions.prompt: At the end of winter the soldiers returned home.
questions.answer: Extrēmā hieme mīlitēs domum revertērunt.

questions.prompt: I was the first who saw the immense fleet.
questions.answer: Prīmus inmēnsam classem vīdī.

questions.prompt: He was the last to withdraw from the burning city.
questions.answer: Ultimus ex urbe ardente dēcessit.

questions.prompt: You were the first to hear the dreadful message.
questions.answer: Prīmus dīrum nūntium audīvistī.

questions.prompt: The old man was the last who departed from the assembly.
questions.answer: Senex postrēmus ē conciliō ēgressus est.

questions.prompt: Many great thoughts were troubling the weary king.
questions.answer: Multae et magnae cōgitātiōnēs fessum rēgem vexābant.

questions.prompt: He endured many and grievous wounds in the battle.
questions.answer: Multa et gravia vulnera in proeliō sustinuit.

questions.prompt: The general gave many and splendid gifts to the soldiers.
questions.answer: Dux multa et splendida dōna mīlitibus dedit.

questions.prompt: Many and famous men came to the funeral.
questions.answer: Multī et clārī virī ad fūnus vēnērunt.

questions.prompt: The tired travelers were sleeping in the depths of the forest.
questions.answer: Fessī viātōrēs in īmā silvā dormiēbant.

questions.prompt: At the far end of the field the shepherd built a hedge.
questions.answer: In extrēmō agrō pāstor saepem struxit.

questions.prompt: From the top of the wall the guards were watching the sea.
questions.answer: Ex summō mūrō custōdēs mare spectābant.

questions.prompt: In the middle of the night a strange sound was heard.
questions.answer: Mediā nocte sonus mīrus audītus est.

questions.prompt: The brave youth was the first to climb the top of the tower.
questions.answer: Fortis iuvenis prīmus summam turrim ascendit.

questions.prompt: In the earliest spring the birds returned to the grove.
questions.answer: Prīmō vēre avēs in lūcum revertērunt.

questions.prompt: She was the last to abandon the sacred hearth.
questions.answer: Ultima sacrum focum relīquit.

questions.prompt: He was the first who dared to cross the deep river.
questions.answer: Prīmus altum flūmen trānsīre ausus est.

questions.prompt: At the top of the citadel the priest offered a sacrifice.
questions.answer: In summā arce sacerdōs sacrificium obtulit.

questions.prompt: The consul was the last who left the senate house.
questions.answer: Cōnsul postrēmus ē cūriā ēgressus est.

questions.prompt: In the last part of the summer a great plague arose.
questions.answer: Extrēmā aestāte magna pestis orta est.
